Our treatment philosophy

Repair. Restore. Replace.

Our philosophy is simple: preserve natural teeth whenever possible, restore what is damaged, and replace only when necessary.

What guides every treatment plan

  • Preserve natural teeth
  • Minimal intervention
  • Less pain and discomfort
  • Time-tested treatments
  • Durable results
  • Transparent recommendations
  • Proper maintenance
  • Regular follow-up

Aesthetic dentistry & smile design

Your smile, carefully designed

Aesthetic dentistry is not simply about making teeth look different. Good smile design should complement your facial features, natural appearance and personal preferences while maintaining healthy function.

Aesthetics and function are planned together, never separately.

Representative image. Individual results vary.

Good to know

Will my teeth look natural?

That is the aim. Shape, size and shade are chosen to suit your face and your other teeth, so the result looks like you, not like a template.

Does whitening damage teeth?

When done properly on healthy teeth, whitening is considered safe. Some people notice temporary sensitivity. We check your teeth and gums first and advise whether it suits you.

How long do results last?

It depends on the treatment and on home care. Whitening fades faster with tea, coffee or smoking, while veneers, crowns and fillings can last many years with good care and regular check-ups.

Is aesthetic treatment only for looks?

No. Good smile design also protects function. We look at the bite and the health of teeth and gums, so the treatment looks good and keeps working.

Images are representative. Results vary from person to person and are discussed during consultation.
